map.附睾穿刺精子获取率评估器按 PESA/MESA 穿刺液浓度与体积估算可活动精子总: Epididymal sperm retrieval rate evaluator estimates total motile sperm from PESA/MESA aspirate concentration and volume, judging whether ICSI or other ART needs are met.
map.：总量=0.5×50=25×10⁶；活动=25×40%=10×10⁶；每卵=10: : Total = 0.5 x 50 = 25 x 10^6; motile = 25 x 40% = 10 x 10^6; per oocyte = 10/8 = 1.25 x 10^6, enough for ICSI.
map.：总量 5×10⁶、活动 1×10⁶、卵 10 → 每卵仅 0.1×10⁶，偏紧: : Total 5 x 10^6, motile 1 x 10^6, oocytes 10 -> only 0.1 x 10^6 per oocyte, tight; consider repeat aspiration or TESE.
map.PESA 经皮粗针、MESA 显微直视，后者更精准但创伤大。: PESA uses percutaneous coarse needle; MESA uses microsurgical direct visualization, more precise but more invasive.
map.每卵多少够？: How many per oocyte is enough?
map.ICSI 单卵仅需数个活动精子，常规获精远大于需求。: ICSI needs only a few motile sperm per oocyte; routine sperm retrieval far exceeds demand.
